children: Following are the results of the Philippine Bureau of the Treasury's (BTr) auction of reissued 2033 T-bonds on Tuesday:
BTr partially awards 20.7 billion pesos ($331.37 million) offer at an average rate of 7.352%
Details on the BTr's website www.treasury.gov.ph
